answer: One concrete mechanism: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because ivory only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, garden is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any mesa approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
